tool_calls.name: run_sql
tool_calls.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS MediaType, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount, ROUND(AVG(t.Milliseconds)/60000.0, 2) AS AvgLengthMinutes
FROM MediaType m
LEFT JOIN Track t USING (MediaTypeId)
GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
ORDER BY m.MediaTypeId;"}
